subagent_input.last_assistant_message:
Extracted 4 falsifiable claims from the Ghostty GitHub Discussion #3054.

Source: https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/discussions/3054 (forum — official GitHub Discussions, but it is a user discussion thread, not formal documentation; collaborator/maintainer statements present which raises reliability above a typical forum).

Key findings relevant to the research question:
- A Ghostty collaborator confirms Ghostty supports Kitty graphics protocol but NOT iTerm2 image protocol or Sixel (central to scope items 1 and 2).
- Chafa works in Ghostty specifically via `-f kitty` (central to scope item 3 on tool protocol dependency).
- A known limitation: Kitty-protocol images linger after fzf exit and need `clear` — but maintainer attributes this to the upstream fzf-preview script / Kitty-level behavior, not a Ghostty-specific bug.

Publish date: 2024-12-21. Status: unanswered/ongoing (no formal resolution marked).
